summary: Added testnet Vea addresses to @kleros/veashi-sdk, with the operator's design-challenge note applied. New: veashi-sdk/scripts/extract-vea.cjs (plain CJS, fs+path only). It reads *Testnet deployments in contracts/deployments/{arbitrumSepolia,sepolia,chiado}, fails if a network's .chainId disagrees with its mapping, fails if an ArbToGnosis route has no router or an unlisted route has one, and writes veashi-sdk/vea/testnet.json (sorted keys, JSON.stringify(...,null,2)+newline) with {inbox,outbox,router?} entries of {address,contract,network}. Also new: veashi-sdk/vea.ts (getVeaRoute returns plain addresses; getVeaInbox, getVeaOutbox, getVeaRouter, getVeaRoutes), exported from index.ts. types.ts gains VeaDeployment, VeaRouteFile and VeaRouteAddresses. package.json adds the exports entry ./vea/testnet.json -> ./dist/vea/testnet.json and the extract:vea script, and extract now runs it after generate-types.sh; files and version are unchanged. README documents the getters, the JSON entry shape and the router table. Setup had not actually been run in this worktree (no node_modules), so I ran setup.sh install and sdk (both passed). Checks run: typecheck (build:ts) passed, with dist/index.js, dist/index.d.ts and dist/vea/testnet.json at the expected paths. vea-data-fresh as written fails before commit only because the new files are untracked or modified. Its intent held: a hash of the veashi-sdk tree (excluding dist and typechain-types) was identical before and after two extract:vea runs. Prettier --check passes on all touched files. npm pack --dry-run includes dist/vea/testnet.json and not the generator, and require.resolve('@kleros/veashi-sdk/vea/testnet.json') resolves. In a sandbox, the generator produced the same output, failed on a bad .chainId, failed on a missing ArbToGnosis router, and dropped a route with no outbox.
open_assumptions: vea-data-fresh must run after the controller commits the worktree: before commit, git status sees the new untracked files and the check fails regardless of correctness.

dist/vea/testnet.json is re-serialized by tsc (4-space indent), so it is byte-different from the committed vea/testnet.json but deep-equal to it (verified). The npm subpath and repo path are both vea/testnet.json.
If a route has a router but its inbox or outbox is missing, the whole route is skipped silently (no error), following 'a route is included only when both inbox and outbox exist'.
The README describes the ArbToGnosis router as sitting on Ethereum (Sepolia) and relaying Arbitrum to Gnosis, from the deployment network and Vea's design.
untested: The full `yarn extract` chain (generate-types.sh && yarn extract:vea) was not run: it needs a forge build of veashi-contracts and its submodules.
Consuming the package from Python or Rust, or through an actual npm install of a packed tarball (only npm pack --dry-run and require.resolve within the workspace were run).
falsifying_check: typecheck; plus the node -e command in verify_yourself, which prints MISMATCH if any getter's address differs from its deployment file
verify_yourself: Run from the repo root after `yarn workspace @kleros/veashi-sdk build:ts`: node -e 'const s=require("./veashi-sdk/dist"),d=(n,c)=>require("./contracts/deployments/"+n+"/"+c+".json").address;for(const[r,g,n,c]of[["421614-11155111","getVeaInbox","arbitrumSepolia","VeaInboxArbToEthTestnet"],["421614-11155111","getVeaOutbox","sepolia","VeaOutboxArbToEthTestnet"],["421614-10200","getVeaInbox","arbitrumSepolia","VeaInboxArbToGnosisTestnet"],["421614-10200","getVeaOutbox","chiado","VeaOutboxArbToGnosisTestnet"],["421614-10200","getVeaRouter","sepolia","RouterArbToGnosisTestnet"]]){const v=s[g](...r.split("-").map(Number)),e=d(n,c);console.log(r,g,v,e,c,v===e?"OK":"MISMATCH")}for(const r of["421614-11155111","10200-421614","42161-1514"]){const a=r.split("-").map(Number);console.log(r,s.getVeaInbox(...a),s.getVeaOutbox(...a),s.getVeaRouter(...a),s.getVeaRoute(...a))}' -- it should print five OK lines, each getter address next to its deployment's address field. Then 421614-11155111 should show an inbox and outbox with router undefined, and 10200-421614 and 42161-1514 should be all undefined. Also confirm that these five deployments are the intended current testnet contracts.
